name: Ventas/Tickets — admin abre Caja desde Registrar venta
description: Un admin entra a Ventas/Tickets, pulsa Registrar venta y es redirigido a la vista Caja POS (ya no abre modal).

planSteps.description: Sign in with the admin email and password configured for this project
Open the Ventas/Tickets section from the sidebar navigation
Verify the Ventas/Tickets page shows a sales table with columns for ID, Producto, Cantidad, SUBT, Descuento, Comisión, Total, Fecha, Método de pago, En corte, and Pagado
Verify the browser navigates to the Caja page with product search and Confirmar compra visible
